items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Like Goon, he had this kind of look.

ctx.x: That’s funny how everybody had nicknames back then, Goon Garner and Scoops Carry.

Yeah, everybody. That’s the first thing they gave you. Just like baseball players. They gave you a little something that people could identify you by easily. And it always fit. Like Goon, he had this kind of look. Then there was one more guy. I forgot about him. His name was Lank Keyes.
